name: dsh-plugin-compose
title_zh: 把 DSH 插件装进 profile，不碰宿主源码
tagline_zh: 还在手改 node_modules 或宿主补丁？用 package.json 的 dsh.bundle.patch。
tagline_en: Stop patching DSH host source. Wire plugins declaratively via dsh.bundle.patch & cordis.patch.yml, then inspect.
desc_en: Use when wiring a standalone DSH plugin into a profile through package.json dsh.bundle.patch and cordis.patch.yml, installing a local or Git package with dsh plugin, inspecting effective rows, and proving activation without patching DSH host source.
why_zh: 把补丁变成可审阅的声明，而不是散落的 diff；装完能查生效行，激活与否可验证，不是黑盒。
why_en: Turns patches into auditable declarations, not scattered diffs; post-install row inspection makes activation verifiable, not a.
limit_zh: 只认 DSH 生态的 plugin 包（本地或 Git 源）；不处理 npm 公有 registry 的依赖解析。
limit_en: Only DSH-ecosystem plugins (local or Git); no npm registry resolution; output ends at effective-row inspection, not runtime validation; requires.
